metadata.source_title: A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability

decision.statement: Use one raw exact computational algebra with an explicit-equivalence, relation-parametric correctness layer; pass relation values explicitly, preserve exact structural equations, use pointwise relations for returned functions, and recover equality by specialization.

alternatives.name: equality-first-then-transport
alternatives.reason: L38 is not automatic transport; it would duplicate relation-level independence, recovery, and iterator proofs.

alternatives.name: explicit-relation-laws-over-raw-functions
alternatives.reason: It preserves exact computation, proves semantic closure once, permits multiple relations on one carrier, and recovers equality as an instance.

alternatives.name: quotient-first-execution
alternatives.reason: Quotient descent requires the same congruence obligations, hides operational representatives, and cannot select among incomparable Section 4 relations.

alternatives.name: single-implicit-setoid-instance
alternatives.reason: The same state carrier has several simultaneous and incomparable observation relations.

alternatives.name: proof-bundled-effects-only
alternatives.reason: Proof-field equality impedes raw algebra and rewriting; bundles remain permitted at trusted admission boundaries.

affected_disposition_nodes.effective_readiness_rule: remove only BD-EQUIV from each node's blocker set; preserve every other blocker and every frozen dependency edge

coding_rules: Expose the selected relation explicitly in every semantic theorem signature.
Do not select theorem meaning through a global Setoid instance in core files.
Do not execute raw semantics on quotients.
Compare function-valued fields pointwise at the selected relation.
Provide Respects proofs for transformations used in relational composites or generated monoids.
Index every inverse witness by the run that returned that inverse.
Preserve definedness and exact outcome or control tags unless a separate relation is supplied.
Name CoreStateObs, LifecycleObs, and EraseControl separately; name LifecycleObs and EraseControl when both occur in a Section 4 theorem.
Generate equality and observational variants by specialization, not copied proofs.
Require a proof of selected-inverse coherence for any claim of full operation admissibility.

acceptance_checks.check: separate raw exact algebra and semantic relation laws
support multiple relations on one carrier without global instance choice
include successor relation, selected-inverse coherence, inverse properness, and local recovery
close lawful effects under exact sequential composition
do not admit L35 selected-inverse inference
realize L38 without theory duplication or weakening structural equations
separate D33 CoreStateObs, D53 LifecycleObs, both paper uses of approx, and name renaming
constrain iterator and failure output relators
keep quotients out of execution state
